purpose: Document first-party discovery, current public map/API routes, bounded anonymous access review, safe-field limits, and uncertainty.
assessment: Official Krishnagiri/Hosur revenue custodian and Tamil Nadu land-record service provenance were found. eAdangal is an attribute lookup form, and TNGIS is a map shell with administrative content and user-supplied WFS upload controls; no anonymous parcel feature response, current configuration, schema, CRS, native ID, or geometry was obtained. No sample GeoJSON is retained.
registryAssessment: registryFound is true for evidenced local/state service provenance: Krishnagiri District publishes Hosur taluk revenue administration and names the Tahsildar/Sub-Collector, while Tamil Nadu Revenue Administration publishes eAdangal. Geometry integration and runtime admission remain unverified.
